div.head: ECf 32 B 4
div.ab: Et qui terram acquietatam habet schire (id est comitatus) testimonio, habeat sine querela in die et post diem ad dandam ei cui plus amabit.
div.note: Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 657 (November 2026): read from the page images and checked against the scan’s own text layer, differences settled against the page.

This passage is not part of ECf or ECf retr: it is one of the additions of the London collection (Leges Anglorum s. XIII in. Londoniis collectae), which Liebermann prints across the page as an insertion into ECf retr. 32 (32 A–E, pp. 655–660). The dictionary cites it as “ECf 32 B …”, so it is kept with ECf here.
Liebermann prints the words borrowed from Quadr. II Cn. 79 in smaller type; his margin names the source (Quadr. II Cn. 79).

note.seg: sc. i. e. lacking in Ld

div.ab: And whoever has land made quit by the witness of the schire (that is, of the shire), let him have it without challenge in his day and after his day, to give to whom he pleases best.
